[[Xtreme Dash|Xtreme Dash Mirror Reflection]] |WBO=https://worldbeyblade.org/Thread-Product-UX-03-Booster-WizardRod-5-70DB }}{{Translation|'''WizardRod 5-70DB'''|ウィザードロッド{{Ruby|5-70|ファイブセブンティー}}{{Ruby|DB|ディスクボール}}|WizādoRoddo Faibu Sebunti Disuku Bōru|WizardRod Five Seventy Disk Ball}} is a Stamina Type Beyblade released by [[Takara Tomy]]. It was released as a Booster in Japan on March 30th, 2024. It later debuted in western countries as '''Wand Wizard 5-70DB''' in a Starter Pack released by [[Hasbro]] for USD$9.99 in the United States.
